vehicles_provider_registration_unique.name: vehicles_provider_registration_unique
vehicles_provider_registration_unique.where: "vehicles"."deleted_at" is null and "vehicles"."registration" is not null

business_promotions_dates.name: business_promotions_dates
business_promotions_dates.value: "business_promotions"."starts_on" is null or "business_promotions"."ends_on" is null or "business_promotions"."ends_on" >= "business_promotions"."starts_on"

business_promotions_limits.name: business_promotions_limits
business_promotions_limits.value: ("business_promotions"."min_days" is null or "business_promotions"."min_days" >= 1) and ("business_promotions"."max_uses" is null or "business_promotions"."max_uses" >= 1)

refund_requests_decision_recorded.name: refund_requests_decision_recorded
refund_requests_decision_recorded.value: "refund_requests"."status" = 'pending' or ("refund_requests"."decided_by_staff_id" is not null and "refund_requests"."decision_reason" is not null)
